name: QCalEval — April 2026 Zero-shot
protocol: QCalEval April-2026 snapshot, 243 samples, zero-shot single-query plot, Table 3 six-axis mean; MM-ICL and tuned variants excluded.

explanation.en: Four axes are programmatically scored and two use two fixed judges; the six scores are equally averaged.
explanation.zh: 四个维度程序化判分，两个维度使用两个固定 judge，最终对六项等权平均。

summary.en: QCalEval evaluates reasoning over quantum-computing calibration plots.
summary.zh: QCalEval 评估模型对量子计算 calibration plots 的综合推理能力。

task_format.en: Inspect each plot and answer six questions on description, outcome, interpretation, fit, parameters, and diagnosis.
task_format.zh: 检查每张图并回答关于描述、结论、解释、拟合、参数和诊断的六类问题。
